name: Germany

paths.name: Holding the portfolio personally
paths.note: Flat tax on dividends and realised gains (Abgeltungsteuer 25% plus solidarity surcharge); unrealised gains are not taxed at death and the heirs keep the original cost.

paths.name: Asset-management GmbH
paths.note: The parents' estate holds the GmbH shares, valued at about the portfolio. An asset-management GmbH is administrative assets, so the business relief of ErbStG §13a/13b does not apply.

checks.working: Foreign dividends 20,000: Abgeltungsteuer 25% = 5,000 (EStG §32d(1)), less the 15% foreign withholding credited, 3,000 (§32d(5)), = 2,000; solidarity surcharge 5.5% of 2,000 = 110 (SolzG §3(1) Nr. 5). Gains 15,000 x 25% = 3,750, plus 5.5% surcharge = 206.25. Total 2,110 + 3,956.25 = 6,066.25. Saver's allowance (EUR 1,000, §20(9)) ignored, as the engine has no allowances.
checks.model_note: The engine subtracts the 15% withholding from the combined 26.375% rate; by law the credit reduces the 25% tax and the surcharge is then charged on what is left, so the engine overstates by 5.5% of the credit (0.055 x 3,000 = 165).

checks.working: Portfolio dividends below 10% are fully taxable (KStG §8b(4)): corporate tax 15% of 20,000 = 3,000, less the 15% foreign withholding credited against corporate tax only (KStG §26), = 0, so no surcharge. Trade tax: dividends below 15% are added back (GewStG §8 Nr. 5): 3.5% base rate x 490% Munich multiplier = 17.15% of 20,000 = 3,430. Gains: 95% exempt (KStG §8b(2),(3)), 5% of 15,000 = 750 taxed at 15.825% + 17.15% = 32.975%, = 247.31. Total 3,677.31.
checks.model_note: The engine credits the withholding against the combined 32.975% rate; by law it reduces corporate tax only and the surcharge falls away with it, so the engine overstates by the surcharge on the credit (0.055 x 3,000 = 165).

checks.working: Each child receives 3,333,333.33, less the EUR 400,000 allowance (ErbStG §16(1) Nr. 2) = 2,933,333.33, taxed in class I at 19% (ErbStG §19(1), band up to 6,000,000) = 557,333.33; the hardship rule of §19(3) does not apply this far above 600,000. Three children: 1,672,000.

assumptions: Church tax is left out (it adds 8-9% of the flat tax for members).
The GmbH's own rates (corporate tax, trade tax, 95% exemption of share gains) come from the vv_gmbh regime in the tax file.

sources.title: Einkommensteuergesetz §32d (flat tax on capital income; credit for foreign tax)
